positions.title: Senior Software Architect
positions.locationName: Small start up company Rochester NY
positions.description: Developed Web Application, Database and Rest interface... complete backend interface too an Android Tablet.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Android application developer for deploying Kodak Perfect tTouch algorithm into Motorola image chain 
•	Software lead for Kodak’s first Android camera. Responsibilities included managing application development by HCL (India) . 
•	Responsible for building Microsoft repositories for Android source code developed on Linux and ported to Microsoft (SVN,CVS & GIT). Built and flashed OS onto devices. Coordinated work with Altec  Camera manufacturer (Taiwan).
•	Software lead for Pulse Digital Frames. Worked with StormFrog.com for server side code and website. Built a desktop frame emulator in C# to connect to the server side for testing. Simplified architecture, thereby reducing server costs by 50%. Liaison between WiPro (India) and StormFrog to test and fix server-side software.

positions.title: Software Supervisor
positions.description:
•	Lead architect  for evaluation of buy-versus-make for printer controllers and drivers for a desktop electro photographic printer. 
•	Supervised small team of embedded engineers to develop the printer controller for the electro photographic printer.

positions.title: Unit Manager
positions.description:
•	Oversaw resource allocation for Kodak executive management to deliver state of the art software technology to high profile, public demonstration venues.
•	Supervised 17 software engineers working for various business units/projects that impacted $100M  in sales of new products and devices.  Successful product launches included: EasyShare One camera and a new 600 dpi scanner.
•	Designed/developed/tested software for demonstration of high-speed photo scanning system. This  included development of the product  GUI. Projected income of $50M annually.

positions.title: Product realization manager
positions.description:
•	Managed mixed group of engineers and technicians.
•	Reviewed all projects as part  of  leadership team
•	Tracked all personnel and project funding for the dept (~90 people).
•	Senior software lead and consultant for many projects
